commands:
if [ -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer ]; then
cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer | mail -E 'set escape' -s "FORMAT DSHIELD USERID 0 TZ `date +%z | sed 's/\([+-]..\)\(..\)/\1:\2/'` Fail2Ban"  reports@dshield.org
date +%s > /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent
fi
rm -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first

TZONE=`date +%z | sed 's/\([+-]..\)\(..\)/\1:\2/'`
DATETIME="`perl -e '@t=localtime(<time>);printf "%4d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d",1900+$t[5],$t[4]+1,$t[3],$t[2],$t[1],$t[0]'` $TZONE"
PROTOCOL=`awk '{IGNORECASE=1;if($1=="tcp"){print $2;exit}}' /etc/protocols`
if [ -z "$PROTOCOL" ]; then PROTOCOL=tcp; fi
printf %b "$DATETIME\t0\t<failures>\t<ip>\t???\t`ip -4 addr show dev eth0 | grep inet | head -n 1 | sed -r 's/.*inet ([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}).*/\1/'`\t???\t$PROTOCOL\t\n" >> /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer
NOW=`date +%s`
if [ ! -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first ]; then
echo <time> | cut -d. -f1 > /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first
fi
if [ ! -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent ]; then
echo 0 > /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent
fi
LOGAGE=$(($NOW - `cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first`))
LASTREPORT=$(($NOW - `cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent`))
LINES=$( wc -l /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer | awk '{ print $1 }' )
if [ $LINES -ge 50 && $LASTREPORT -gt 3600 ] || [ $LOGAGE -gt 21600 ]; then
cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer | mail -E 'set escape' -s "FORMAT DSHIELD USERID 0 TZ $TZONE Fail2Ban"  reports@dshield.org
rm -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first
echo $NOW > /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent
fi

if [ -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first ]; then
NOW=`date +%s`
LOGAGE=$(($NOW - `cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first`))
if [ $LOGAGE -gt 21600 ]; then
cat /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer | mail -E 'set escape' -s "FORMAT DSHIELD USERID 0 TZ `date +%z | sed 's/\([+-]..\)\(..\)/\1:\2/'` Fail2Ban"  reports@dshield.org
rm -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.buffer /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.first
echo $NOW > /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-dshield.lastsent
fi
fi

files.jail.local:
[o-a-dshield]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = dshield
